name: e11_question_cond
_purpose: Co-attention discussion follow-up: does making the bridge's pooling weights a function of the question (instead of static/question-blind) help, as a linear-time non-attention approximation of co-attention's question-relevance signal? Built on top of the v4 (320px) final primary config -- the current best. Primary-only architectural lever (like bridge-layers/multi-head-pool/global-token) -- not mirrored to baseline per the fairness rule (baseline's Transformer already implicitly attends question<->all-tokens). Control = e10_resolution_confirm's existing primary_320 seed360/361/362 results (0.4838/0.4798 mean, ledger), reused, not rerun.
